UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User hydration goal, unit preference, and push reminder schedule settings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this hydration profile.

dailyGoalMl.description: Daily hydration target in milliliters (500 to 10000).

preferredUnit.description: Display unit preference for volume formatting.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether scheduled hydration reminder notifications are enabled.

reminderIntervalMinutes.description: Interval between hydration reminders in minutes (30 to 480).

wakeHour.description: Start hour (0-23) for active hydration reminders.

sleepHour.description: End hour (0-23) for active hydration reminders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WaterLog.title: WaterLog
WaterLog.description: An individual hydration intake entry logged by the user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this log entry.

amountMl.description: Volume of beverage consumed in milliliters (10 to 5000).

dateKey.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

loggedAtMillis.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the drink was logged.

note.description: Optional short note or container label (max 80 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each user's hydration goals and reminder preferences.

/users/{userId}/water_logs/{logId}.description: Stores timestamped hydration intake entries for each user.
